track.name: sustainability
track.label: ESG & Business Models
track.summary: Learn how companies actually measure, manage and report ESG performance — from carbon accounting and materiality assessments to the GRI, SASB and TCFD frameworks investors and regulators now expect.

phases.title: ESG Fundamentals & Materiality
phases.description: The vocabulary, drivers and materiality process behind every ESG program, and how it differs from CSR and sustainability.

phases.title: Environmental Strategy & Carbon Accounting
phases.description: How companies measure their carbon footprint across all three emissions scopes and turn that into a credible net-zero strategy.

phases.title: Social Impact & Stakeholder Capitalism
phases.description: Stakeholder capitalism, human rights due diligence in supply chains, and how to actually measure social impact.

phases.title: Governance & Business Ethics
phases.description: The governance structures, ethics programs and anti-corruption controls that make the 'G' in ESG real.

phases.title: ESG Reporting & Frameworks
phases.description: The reporting frameworks — GRI, SASB, TCFD — and rating agencies that turn ESG performance into numbers investors can compare.

phases.title: Sustainable Business Models & Applied Practice
phases.description: Circular economy business models, embedding ESG into corporate strategy, and real-company case studies to tie it all together.

topics.title: What is ESG?
topics.description: The environmental, social and governance pillars, and why the term now shapes how investors and regulators size up a company.

topics.title: Materiality Assessment
topics.description: How to identify which ESG topics are financially or socially material enough to actually report on.

topics.title: ESG vs CSR vs Sustainability
topics.description: Where these three overlapping terms diverge in scope, measurability and audience.

topics.title: Corporate Carbon Footprinting
topics.description: Setting organizational and operational boundaries and calculating a company's baseline emissions footprint.

topics.title: Scope 1, 2 & 3 Emissions
topics.description: The GHG Protocol's three-scope system for classifying direct, energy and value-chain emissions.

topics.title: Climate Risk & Net Zero Strategy
topics.description: Turning emissions data into a credible, science-based net-zero target and transition plan.

topics.title: Stakeholder Capitalism Fundamentals
topics.description: The shift from shareholder primacy to weighing employees, customers, suppliers and communities alongside investors.

topics.title: Human Rights & Labor Standards in Supply Chains
topics.description: The UN and ILO frameworks companies use to identify and remedy human rights risk across their supply chains.

topics.title: Community & Social Impact Measurement
topics.description: Frameworks and free tools for measuring a company's social impact beyond financial statements.

topics.title: Corporate Governance Fundamentals
topics.description: How boards, shareholders and management responsibilities are structured to keep a company accountable.

topics.title: Business Ethics & Anti-Corruption
topics.description: Building the ethics and compliance programs that keep bribery and corruption out of day-to-day business.

topics.title: Board Oversight of ESG
topics.description: Which board committee should own which ESG risk, and how boards are actually structuring that oversight.

topics.title: GRI Standards
topics.description: The most widely used global standard for sustainability reporting, and how its modular structure works.

topics.title: SASB & TCFD Frameworks
topics.description: Industry-specific SASB metrics and TCFD's climate-risk disclosure pillars, now consolidated under the ISSB.

topics.title: ESG Ratings & Investor Expectations
topics.description: How agencies like MSCI turn ESG performance into a letter rating, and what investors actually do with it.

topics.title: Circular Economy Business Models
topics.description: Business models built on designing out waste instead of the traditional take-make-dispose model.

topics.title: ESG Integration in Corporate Strategy
topics.description: Why ESG initiatives that sit apart from core strategy tend to fail, and what real integration looks like.

topics.title: Case Studies in Corporate Sustainability
topics.description: Real companies' sustainability strategies, and the empirical business case behind them.
